# Glenhold Bookkeeping

Simi Valley-based business bookkeeping. Work directly with Jack, a former Big 4 accountant and Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. Glenhold Bookkeeping is the client-facing name of Glenhold Advisory LLC.

Phone: (805) 419-3451
Email: jack@glenhold.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@bookkeepingbizblueprint (Bookkeeping Business Blueprint)

Monthly starting prices are $350 for Essential, $450 for Core, and $700 for Strategic. Quotes depend on volume, accounts, and reporting complexity. Cleanup and training are quoted separately. Tax return preparation and filing are separate from the listed bookkeeping plans.
